items.stem: A rectangle has length (5x + 3) cm and breadth (2x + 3) cm. Write its perimeter as a polynomial and find the perimeter when x = 5.
The table x: 1, 2, 3, 4 and y: 10, 18, 26, 34 is said to follow a linear rule. Explain how you can tell from the table alone.
items.answer: The differences in y are constant (8) for equal steps in x.
items.markingKey: Constant first difference for equal steps in x ⇒ linear (2 marks).

items.stem: A water tank of capacity 1500 L already has 300 L in it. A pump adds 80 L per minute. (i) Write V(t), the volume after t minutes. (ii) What are the intercept and the rate of change of the graph of V against t? (iii) After how many minutes is the tank full? (iv) Why is the graph only drawn for 0 ≤ t ≤ 15?
items.answer: (i) V = 80t + 300 (ii) intercept 300 L, rate 80 L/min (iii) 15 min (iv) before t = 0 nothing is pumped and after 15 min the tank overflows
items.markingKey: 1 mark each part.

items.stem: If p(x) = ax − 17 and p(5) = −42, find a.
For the line y = x + 4, by how much does y change when x increases by 1?
items.markingKey: The coefficient of x (1) is the rate of change.

items.stem:
Assertion (A): The table x: 1, 2, 3, 4; y: 9, 13, 17, 21 follows a linear rule.
Reason (R): A rule is linear when y changes by the same amount for each unit increase in x.
Choose the correct option.
items.answer: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
items.markingKey: (a) Differences are all 4.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.

items.stem: Simplify (4x² − 8x − 1) + (−9x² + 9x − 6).
items.markingKey: Add the coefficients of like terms: x², x and the constants.

items.stem: Fatima has ₹300 and saves ₹500 every month; Siddharth has ₹1300 and saves ₹450 every month. Write each person's savings as y = ax + b (x months), and find after how many months they will have equal savings and how much each will have then.
items.answer: Fatima: y = 500x + 300; Siddharth: y = 450x + 1300; after 20 months, ₹10300 each
items.markingKey: Two linear rules (2), equating (1), solving and value (2).

items.stem: Explain why the linear polynomial 5x + 17 has exactly one zero, and find it.
items.markingKey: 5x + 17 = 0 is a linear equation with a ≠ 0, which has exactly one solution x = −b/a = −17/5 (2 marks).

items.stem: Find a linear rule y = ax + b for the table x: 1, 2, 3, 4 and y: 9, 15, 21, 27. Use it to find y when x = 43.
items.markingKey: Constant difference a = 6; b = 9 − 6 = 3; y(43) = 261.
